set -euo pipefail
: "${A9_EVIDENCE_DIR:?}" "${RISCV_SOURCE_HEAD:?}"

commands=(
 'cargo fmt --all -- --check'
 'cargo check --all-features'
 'cargo clippy --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings'
 'cargo test --all-features'
 'cargo doc --all-features --no-deps'
 'bash scripts/test_riscv_elf_guards.sh'
 'RISCV_REQUIRE_RISCV_TOOLCHAIN=1 cargo test --test a6_trap_elf_integration -- --nocapture'
 'RISCV_TEST_OUTDIR=target/a9-fresh-riscv-elves ./scripts/compile_riscv_tests.sh'
 'RISCV_TEST_OUTDIR=target/a9-fresh-riscv-elves ./scripts/run_elf_tests.sh'
)
for i in "${!commands[@]}"; do
 command="${commands[$i]}"
 printf 'START %s %s %s\n' "$((i+1))" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$command" | tee -a "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/status.txt"
 set +e
 bash -c "$command" > "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/$((i+1)).log" 2>&1
 status=$?
 set -e
 printf 'END %s %s status=%s\n' "$((i+1))" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$status" | tee -a "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/status.txt"
 if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then tail -80 "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/$((i+1)).log"; exit "$status"; fi
 if [ "$i" = 7 ]; then
  cp "$RISCV_TEST_OUTDIR/manifest.txt" "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/explicit-compile-manifest.txt"

 fi
done
cp "$RISCV_TEST_OUTDIR/manifest.txt" "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/run-rebuild-manifest.txt"
find "$RISCV_TEST_OUTDIR" -name '*.elf' -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum > "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/run-rebuild-sha256.txt"
sha256sum "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release/ruscv-sim" > "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/simulator-sha256.txt"
find tests/bare-metal-riscv-test -type f \( -name '*.S' -o -name linker.ld \) | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum > "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/source-sha256.txt"
diff -u "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/explicit-compile-sha256.txt" "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/run-rebuild-sha256.txt" > "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/rebuild-diff.txt"
printf 'COMPLETE %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" | tee -a "$A9_EVIDENCE_DIR/status.txt"
